title: Chinstrap Penguin Ka 4-Second Sleep Secret! 🐧 #shorts
idea: Chinstrap penguins microsleep over 10,000 times a day for just 4 seconds at a time to get 11 hours of sleep while guarding their nests.

lines.text: Kya ek jaanwar din mein 10,000 baar so sakta hai?
Chinstrap penguin har din 10,000 se zyada baar microsleep leta hai.
Har neend sirf 4 second ki hoti hai, bilkul ek jhatke ki tarah!
Aise chote nap milakar ye roz poore 11 ghante ki neend lete hain.
Ye andon ki rakhwali karte hue bhi aise hi chote nap leta hai!
Agar aapko har 4 second mein neend aaye, toh kya hoga?

They accumulate about 11 hours of sleep each day.
